findings.body: The `first_sentence` function splits on the first occurrence of `. `. This incorrectly splits on abbreviations like 'e.g.' or 'i.e.' that are followed by a space and more text. For example, input `e.g. this is a test.` would return `e.g.` instead of the full first sentence. Since this function is used for one-line summaries of model-authored findings, such input is reachable. Consider a more robust sentence boundary detection, or document the limitation.
findings.title: Handle abbreviated punctuation in sentence extraction

value.summary: One issue found: `first_sentence` uses a naive split on `. ` that can be fooled by common abbreviations like 'e.g.', producing an incorrect summary.
